product_one_liner.value: Obsidian Security provides a SaaS and AI security platform that gives enterprise security teams visibility, threat detection, and governance controls over third-party apps, human and non-human identities, and AI agents across their SaaS estate.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage: 'delivers complete SaaS security - gain control, stop threats, and ensure compliance across all your business apps'; press release: 'secures the AI-first enterprise, governing data, AI and agents inside third-party applications', trusted by Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page ('Flexible SaaS Security Pricing') exists: 'Start free. Expand into the modules your team needs, across AI and third-party application security. No bloated bundles.' It lists a free start and modular plans without dollar figures, which still counts as a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Customers page shows logos/quotes (Seagate CIO quote, TELUS quote); careers page: 'trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Wyndham Hotels and Resorts'; dedicated case-study pages exist for Snowflake, T-Mobile, Wyndham, TELUS, Upwork, BigCommerce, and Algolia.

employee_band.notes: Crustdata: 260 employees as of September 2026; TipRanks: 272 employees as of November 9, 2026; Revelio Labs: ~249-250 in 2026. All fall in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: Company press release: 'Headquartered in Palo Alto, California'; LinkedIn company page: Headquarters Palo Alto, California, US.

founded_year.notes: Careers page: 'Founded in 2017'; LinkedIn company page: Founded 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The single marketing blog covers product spotlights, AI-security thought leadership and announcements mostly authored by 'Obsidian Security Team' or marketing staff. Only one post about how the product is built by engineers was found ('Modern Threat Detection: Making Impossible Travel Possible', co-authored by a Senior Security Researcher and a Machine Learning Engineer); with only that lone engineering post, the bar of two engineer-authored build posts is not met.

public_docs.notes: docs.obsidiansecurity.com exists but is gated to customers: it renders 'Session Expired - To access Obsidian's product documentation, please click the book icon in your Obsidian portal', so there is no public docs site or developer portal with several articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live job board lists 'AI Security Engineer - Taiwan' (job 5406173008), plus 'Agent Security Research Engineer - Taiwan' and 'Software Engineer - AI Security Product'.

model_provider.notes: Obsidian's own AI Assistant pages describe a governed multi-agent system built on its platform and MCP orchestration but never name an underlying LLM vendor; the trust-center subprocessor list names Zendesk, Twilio, Google Cloud, Databricks and AWS only; product docs are login-gated. References to OpenAI, Anthropic, Copilot etc. concern the customer AI platforms Obsidian secures, not its own model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center compliance section lists IRAP, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 with downloadable certificates and a SOC 2 report. Of the five certifications in scope, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are named (ISO 27701 and ISO 42001 fall outside the requested five).

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated August 4, 2026: '$85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from all existing investors including Greylock Partners and Menlo Ventures' at a $1.1B valuation; CB Insights confirms latest round was Series D for $85M on August 4, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: $85M Series D announced August 4, 2026 - about 3 months before the 2026-11-09 run date, well inside the 18-month window (since 2025-05-09).

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Greenhouse board lists four Enterprise Account Executive roles: San Francisco Bay Area, Central US, EMEA (UK), and ANZ (Melbourne).

launched_6mo.notes: Within the 6 months before 2026-11-09: connector coverage expansion to 200+ enterprise applications announced May 14, 2026; Claude Compliance API integration announced July 21, 2026; Databricks Silver partner status and Unity AI Gateway launch-partner role announced September 15, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Yanxin Zhang's LinkedIn profile shows he joined Obsidian Security as VP of Engineering, Platform and Infrastructure starting 2026-06-01 - a VP-level hire inside the 12-month window ending 2026-11-09. The company is also currently recruiting a Chief Information Security Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: RepVue's Obsidian Security tech-stack page (employee-reported) lists Salesforce (CRM), Outreach, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and ZoomInfo in the sales/marketing stack.
